name: Task persistence
purpose: Persist the todo list to a JSON file on disk, atomically, so a crash cannot corrupt the store
description: 负责把任务列表安全地写入磁盘文件：每次变更整体重写，进程崩掉也不会留下写了一半的存储。重启后任务不丢全靠这一层。

key_concepts.name: atomic rewrite
key_concepts.explanation: the whole JSON document is rewritten on every mutation, never appended

key_concepts.name: crash safety
key_concepts.explanation: 崩溃安全：写入中途进程死掉，磁盘上的数据仍然完整可读

files.purpose: TaskStore: JSON-file persistence for tasks with atomic saves

name: Command line interface
purpose: Wire the add/list/done subcommands and the command-line entry point
description: 命令行入口与子命令接线：add、list、done 怎么注册、参数怎么解析。

key_concepts.name: subcommands
key_concepts.explanation: add, list and done subcommand wiring

files.purpose: forwards to the cli entry point

name: Task model and validation
purpose: The Task model and the validation of field values such as priority
description: 任务的数据模型与字段校验，比如 priority 的合法取值判定。

key_concepts.name: priority validation
key_concepts.explanation: validate_priority decides which priority values are legal

name: Due date parsing
purpose: Parse due dates, including the +Nd and +Nw shorthand
description: 到期日解析，支持 +Nd、+Nw 这类简写。

name: Configuration
purpose: Where settings come from, including the default store path when no config file exists
description: 配置从哪里来；没有配置文件时存储路径的默认值在哪决定。

key_concepts.name: default store path
key_concepts.explanation: default_store_path picks the store location without a config file
